scope: Internal BRISC nested calibration comparison; not clinical validation

final_all_validation.status: proposed only; not used for reported metrics

gate.rule: Aggregate lesion-centered ECE <=0.03 and each predicted tumor route lesion-centered ECE <=0.05.

operational_eligibility_reason: At least one selected outer or final configuration requires reference-region routing.
limitations: Candidates containing R require reference-mask routing and are oracle diagnostics.
Reliability weighting transfers frozen v1 OOF scores to E08.
All metrics use the internal validation partition used during model development.
Patient independence and external generalization are unverified.
